heard: Admiral Vernon minted medals celebrating a victory that never happened. In 1741, London minted coins showing the Spanish commander kneeling in surrender. But the defender Blas de Lazo outmaneuvered the massive British fleet. Night assault failed when scaling ladders were 10 feet too short. Disease killed over 9,000 men during the 67-day siege. The humiliation eventually collapsed the British government. men. Those medals remained, celebrating a victory that never happened.
